title: Novera Protocol v0.1 shared definitions
description: Reusable definitions referenced by every Novera Protocol v0.1 record schema. This document defines no record of its own. The $id is a stable canonical identifier; it is not a statement that a hosted schema service is available at that URL.

specVersion.description: Specification version the record conforms to. Producers MUST set this value; consumers MUST reject records whose specVersion they do not support.

opaqueId.description: Opaque Novera protocol identifier: a three-letter type prefix, an underscore, and 26 lowercase Crockford base32 characters (128 bits of entropy or a time-ordered value of equal length). Consumers MUST NOT parse meaning from the body. Network addresses, token identifiers and transaction hashes MUST NOT be used as opaque identifiers.

participantId.description: Opaque identifier of a NovaID participant record.

assetId.description: Opaque identifier of a NovaRegistry asset record.

workflowId.description: Opaque identifier of a NovaDeed workflow record.

evidenceId.description: Opaque identifier of an evidence record.

policyResultId.description: Opaque identifier of a policy-result record.

claimId.description: Opaque identifier of a claim held within a NovaID participant record.

issuerId.description: Opaque identifier of a claim or evidence issuer, such as an identity provider, financial institution, professional or the participant itself.

systemId.description: Opaque identifier of a software system acting within a Novera deployment, such as a workflow engine, a policy evaluator or a future assistive system.

adapterId.description: Opaque identifier of a configured settlement or network adapter instance.

localKey.description: Key that is unique only within the enclosing record, used to cross-reference entries inside that record.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit offset. UTC (suffix Z) is RECOMMENDED. Timestamps record when an assertion was made; they do not establish legal effective dates.

extensionToken.description: Namespaced extension value of the form <namespace>:<value>, for vocabulary not defined by this specification. Namespaces SHOULD identify the defining organization or profile. Extension values MUST NOT redefine the meaning of a core value.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable reason code. Dot-separated lowercase segments, optionally namespaced (for example conditions.all_met or acme:manual_hold).

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, optionally followed by an ISO 3166-2 subdivision suffix (for example CA or CA-ON). Synthetic examples use the user-assigned code XZ to avoid implying a real jurisdiction.

confidence.description: Producer-reported confidence between 0 and 1. Confidence is informational; it never substitutes for validation or confirmation.

scope.description: Context to which a claim, eligibility state or policy result applies. Scoped statements MUST NOT be reused outside their scope. There is deliberately no global scope: no Novera statement is an unqualified truth about a participant or asset.

contextType.description: Kind of context: workflow (one NovaDeed workflow), asset (one NovaRegistry asset), program (a named program or offering defined by an operator), deployment (one Novera deployment and its operator rules).

contextId.description: Identifier of the context. REQUIRED when contextType is workflow or asset.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction whose rules the statement was made under, where relevant.

purpose.description: Purpose for which the statement was made, for example real_estate.purchase.

digest.description: Cryptographic digest of content or of a canonicalized record. Lowercase hexadecimal. SHA-256 is RECOMMENDED for v0.1.

value.description: Lowercase hexadecimal digest value whose length matches the algorithm.

metadata.description: Non-normative, namespaced metadata. Keys MUST be namespaced (<namespace>:<key>). Metadata MUST NOT carry personal data, secrets or state that affects protocol semantics. The novera namespace is reserved by this specification.

novera:synthetic.description: True when the record is synthetic example or test data and describes no real person, organization, asset or transaction.

novera:label.description: Human-readable label. Synthetic examples MUST use the label SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE DATA.

actorType.description: Category of actor. Closed vocabulary, because authority rules depend on it: participant (a NovaID participant), system (a deterministic Novera system component), assistive_system (a non-authoritative assistive component such as future Novera Intelligence), external_provider (an external issuer or provider), adapter (a settlement or network adapter).

actorRef.description: Reference to the actor responsible for an event, evaluation or review. Authentication of the actor is the responsibility of the implementation and is not established by this reference alone.

actorId.description: Opaque identifier of the actor. The prefix MUST match actorType.

role.description: Role in which the actor acted, for example buyer_counsel. Core roles are defined by the relevant workflow profile; extension roles use a namespace.

onBehalfOf.description: Participant on whose behalf the actor acted, when acting as an agent or representative.

subjectType.description: Type of Novera record a reference points to.

subjectRef.description: Typed reference to a Novera record.

subjectId.description: Opaque identifier of the referenced record. The prefix MUST match subjectType.

subjectIdBinding.description: Constrains subjectId to the identifier type implied by subjectType.

stateRef.description: Reference to one version of a Novera record. The digest is the state digest defined in architecture/state-model.md: SHA-256 over the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonical JSON of the record at that version with the top-level members transitions, updatedAt and metadata removed. Excluding history and bookkeeping lets a proposer compute the digest of the state it proposes before the transition is applied.

subjectId.description: Opaque identifier of the referenced record.

version.description: Record version referenced. Versions start at 1 and increase by exactly 1 for each confirmed change.

state.description: Optional human-readable state label at that version, for example a NovaDeed workflowState. Informational; the digest is authoritative for the reference.

digest.description: Digest of the canonical record at that version.

issuer.description: Description of a party that issues claims or evidence. Issuer descriptions identify organizations or roles; they MUST NOT contain personal data about natural persons.

issuerType.description: Category of issuer. self means the participant asserted the claim about itself.

displayName.description: Organization or role name of the issuer. For self-issued claims use a role description such as Participant (self-asserted).

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction in which the issuer operates, where relevant.

externalRef.description: Reference to a record held in a system outside Novera. When relationship is authoritative_source, the external record is authoritative and the Novera record is not.

refKey.description: Key unique within the enclosing record, used by relationships to point at this reference.

system.description: Name of the external system or authority.

identifier.description: Identifier of the record within the external system.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction of the external system, where relevant.

uri.description: Optional locator for the external record. MUST NOT embed credentials or personal data.

relationship.description: How the external record relates to the Novera record: authoritative_source (the external record governs), corroborating (supports but does not govern), informational.

verificationStatus.description: What Novera knows about the reference: unverified (asserted only), referenced (located through evidence), confirmed_by_source (the external system or its authorized agent confirmed it), disputed, unavailable (the external system could not be reached).

observedAt.description: When the reference was last observed or checked.

networkRef.description: Reference to an object on a distributed ledger or other network, produced and interpreted only by a network adapter. Network references are never canonical Novera identifiers.

adapterId.description: Adapter instance that produced or interprets the reference.

network.description: CAIP-2 chain identifier (namespace:reference) of the network.

value.description: Network-native reference value, such as a transaction hash. Opaque to the core.

finality.description: Adapter-reported finality: not_observed, observed (seen but not final under the adapter's policy), adapter_final (final under the adapter's documented policy), reorganized (no longer in the canonical history), failed.

observedAt.description: When the adapter last observed the reference.
